create_ModuleDescriptor: create a ModuleDescriptor NamedTuple to describe how to instantiate and test a Haiku module
build_Recurrent_wrapper: build a Recurrent wrapper class that unrolls an RNNCore module with a given unroller function
create_Training_wrapper: create a Training wrapper class that calls a Haiku module with is_training set to True
use_unwrap_function: use the unwrap function to extract the original module from nested Wrapped instances
run_unroll_descriptors: run unroll_descriptors to transform RNN core descriptors into Recurrent wrapped descriptors with a specific unroller
